messages:
elaine: Heads-up — found a dead link in the KB page while doing sprint review. The auth snippet shortlink 404s in the runtime quickstart. Can someone take a quick PR? https://kb.internal/runtime/quickstart
ryan: I can take it, which exact URL is failing?
elaine: The asset link is https://assets.internal/curl-examples/auth.md — returns 404. Looks like we moved the snippet to /examples/auth.md last month.
ryan: got it — I'll open a tiny PR to update the shortlink. ETA ~30m. @docs-bot can you run a link-scan on that page after I land?
docs-bot: scheduled link-scan for thread 1715202024 — will post results in ~5m
sanika: quick question — is the canonical source the snippets repo or the KB itself? Prefer canonical be snippets repo so we don't drift.
elaine: canonical is github.com/redwood/snippets, the KB should shortlink to the raw file there.
mike: small security lint: update the curl auth header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN` instead of the old `-H "Auth: $TOKEN"`.
ryan: noted, will change. quick diff I plan to include:
```
- curl -H \"Auth: $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
+ curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
elaine: also — frontmatter owner is empty on that KB page. Please add yourself as owner (or @sanika if you want to hand off).
ryan: will add myself in frontmatter and include a one-line changelog entry.
sanika: if you add yourself, please file a small ticket so platform docs team can reassign if needed.
elaine: great. @ryan ping me when PR is up so I can queue it for the docs sprint review.
ryan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — includes shortlink fix, snippet header change, and frontmatter owner. Link-scan passed locally.
elaine: :raised_hands: perfect — I'll do a quick review and merge once CI passes. Thanks!
docs-bot: link-scan passed for https://kb.internal/runtime/quickstart — 0 broken links
mike: :thumbsup:
